protocol.title: Microfluidic Cell Retention Device for Perfusion of Mammalian Suspension Culture
protocol.platform: Inertial microfluidic spiral channel (PDMS) coupled to stirred perfusion bioreactor
cell_lines: CHO-DG44 (Chinese hamster ovary, IgG1-producing against CD40 ligand)
protocol.objective: Clog-free, membrane-less cell retention for continuous perfusion culture of suspended mammalian CHO cells using inertial sorting; demonstrated with high cell density (>20e6 cells/mL), long-term run (18-25 days), high IgG1 recovery (>99%), and cell viability (>97%)

channel_dimension_modified_highdensity.notes: Used for 30-40e6 cells/mL; 4 mL/min input; R_OO/R_IO = 1:0.1

fluidic_resistance_ratio.notes: Resistance set by small-diameter tubing (EW-06420-02, Cole-Parmer) length and diameter; higher R_OO moves streamline boundary toward outer outlet, increasing cell retention

cell_retention_principle.mechanism: Inertial microfluidics (no membrane, no active field)

forces.lift_force_FL: Shear gradient-induced + wall-induced lift; FL proportional to a^4
forces.dean_drag_FD: Counter-rotating Dean vortices in curved channel; FD proportional to a
forces.equilibrium: CHO cells (17.7 +/- 2.5 um diameter) focused near inner wall at optimal flow rate

advantages_over_membrane: No product retention (IgG1 passes freely through ~100 um channel)
Dead cell debris and small non-viable cells can be removed via outer outlet

reagents.cell_line: CHO-DG44 producing human IgG1 against CD40 ligand (gifted from Biogen Idec, MA, USA)
reagents.culture_medium: CD OptiCHO (12681011, Thermo Fisher Scientific) + 50 uM L-methionine sulfoximine (M5379, Sigma-Aldrich)
reagents.sterilisation: 10% bleach (10 min) then 70% ethanol (10 min) via peristaltic pump
reagents.igg1_reference_standard: Purified IgG1-Kappa from human myeloma plasma (I5154, Sigma-Aldrich)
reagents.viability_stain: Trypan blue exclusion (BioProfile FLEX and CDV Analyzers, Nova Biomedical)
reagents.hplc_elution_buffer: 100 mM phosphate + 0.4% (v/v) phosphoric acid (85 wt%, Sigma-Aldrich), pH 2.5

bioreactor.type: Spinner flask customised for DO and pH control

steps.name: Device priming and sterilisation
steps.notes: 2% Pluronics F-127 in PBS; reduces cell adhesion to PDMS. Device pre-sterilised with 10% bleach (10 min) then 70% ethanol (10 min) via peristaltic pump (07522-20, Masterflex). Connected to sidearm ports of spinner flask and harvest bottle in biosafety cabinet.

steps.name: Batch growth phase (Days 0-4, no perfusion)
steps.medium: 400 mL pre-warmed CD OptiCHO + 50 uM MSX
steps.duration_note: 4 days = 5760 min (BioScript m token; h not supported)
steps.notes: CHO cells inoculated by peristaltic pump from inoculation bottle into spinner flask. Batch mode (no perfusion) for Days 0-4 to establish viable exponential culture. pH (7.0) and DO (40%) monitored and controlled. Working volume maintained at ~350 mL by customised weight-based software.

steps.name: Perfusion initiation and continuous cell retention (Days 4-18/25)
steps.operation: mix (inertial sorting recirculation abstraction) + heat (37 C)
steps.notes: Fresh CD OptiCHO medium supplied continuously at 2 VVD. Cell culture continuously pumped through 4-spiral device at 1 mL/min. CHO cells focused near inner wall by inertial forces; retained via inner outlet. Harvest (IgG1) collected from outer outlet. Working volume maintained at ~350 mL. Harvest bottle replaced daily.

steps.name: IgG1 product recovery measurement (daily QC)
steps.instrument: HPLC affinity chromatography (Agilent 1100 Series, Applied Biosystems 2-1001-00 column)
steps.notes: Spiral device has no micro- or nanoporous membrane; IgG1 (smallest channel ~100 um) passes freely into harvest stream. No product retention. Recovery close to 100% from Day 3 onward.

steps.name: Cell viability assessment (daily QC)
steps.imaging: 40 images from 40 different fields of view per measurement; cell diameter by pixel distance
steps.instrument: BioProfile FLEX and CDV Analyzers (Nova Biomedical)

perfusion_culture_results.notes: Peak cell concentration 4x higher than batch cultures using same cell line. Glucose-limited environment maintained stably after Day 10. No noticeable cell accumulation in spiral device.

scalability.modified_chip_quadruple_throughput: width 1000 um, inner depth 260 um, outer depth 80 um; 4 mL/min input

large_scale_estimate.channel_spec: 1000 um width, 260 um inner depth, 80 um outer depth
large_scale_estimate.layers: single layer = 4 channels, 2 mm thick; ~600 channels stacked
large_scale_estimate.notes: Uniform flow distribution demonstrated in 10-layer simulation (Supplementary Fig. S6). If one channel fails, stacked device retention drops by 1% only.

comparison_with_other_technologies.ATF_TFF: Membrane fouling, product retention, contamination risk on filter replacement
comparison_with_other_technologies.acoustic_wave: Requires high-frequency (~2 MHz) ultrasonic transducers; additional active components
comparison_with_other_technologies.centrifugation: High shear stress; high operation and maintenance costs
comparison_with_other_technologies.inclined_sedimentation: Long cell residence time; low retention efficiency at high cell concentration
comparison_with_other_technologies.this_work: Passive, no active field, no membrane, clog-free, benign to cells, scalable by parallelisation; material (PDMS) compatible with pharmaceutical manufacturing; injection-moulding polystyrene feasible for lower unit cost

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.contents: device priming, batch growth, perfusion initiation, cell retention detect
